_doc: The volcanic ground's woods (bead bzc.125, docs/art/classes/trees.md): dead charred trees and ember snags, in the wasteland art family's folder as their own species (the wasteland woods never draw them). generate-image-v2 at 48 x 48 like set trees (one call returns many candidates of a mixed subject); the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box plus 1 px. Never scaled, never mirrored. Layers: style, light, class-tree, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one small dead tree of a volcanic plain, chunky and cute, each image a different one of these: a charred dead tree with a thick trunk and a few bare twisted branches of burnt black wood #2e2628 (light #5a4a48 on the left side), a few thin glowing orange ember cracks #f07a2a in the bark; a burnt tree snag, a broken black trunk with two short stubby branches and orange ember tips; a dead tree with ash-grey bark #6a6266 (shadow #3e383c) and a crooked bare crown; a dead black tree with a few red-orange leaves #e8502a still clinging to it. A short trunk at the bottom. About half of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.
recipes.negative: face, eyes, person, ground, grass, green leaves, flames, smoke, fire
